new_sources.summary: Artificial intelligence is changing how we learn, communicate, create, work, and even explore spiritual questions. It can explain Bible passages, compose prayers, imitate compassion, and offer personal guidance—but can a machine understand spiritual truth, know God, or become a disciple of Christ? The Digital Disciple examines the opportunities and spiritual dangers of artificial intelligence from a clear, Christ-centred perspective. It considers how Christians can use AI without confusing generated words with the Word of God, simulated compassion with genuine love, or immediate answers with divine guidance. It also explores biblical discernment, prayer, truth and deception, digital idolatry
new_sources.title: The Digital Disciple
